parameters.query:
UPDATE bookings.membership_invoices
SET
  amount_paid = LEAST(total_amount, amount_paid + $1::numeric),
  status      = CASE
                  WHEN (amount_paid + $1::numeric) >= total_amount THEN 'paid'
                  WHEN (amount_paid + $1::numeric) > 0             THEN 'partial'
                  ELSE status
                END,
  paid_at     = CASE
                  WHEN (amount_paid + $1::numeric) >= total_amount THEN NOW()
                  ELSE paid_at
                END,
  updated_at  = NOW()
WHERE id = $2::uuid
  AND tenant_id = $3
RETURNING
  id AS invoice_id,
  invoice_month::text,
  total_amount,
  amount_paid,
  balance_due,
  status,
  customer_id,
  membership_id;

INSERT INTO bookings.payments
  (tenant_id, booking_id, customer_id,
   payment_date, payment_type, payment_method,
   amount, status, reference_number)
VALUES
  ($1, NULL, $2::uuid,
   NOW()::date, 'membership', $3,
   $4::numeric, 'completed', '7-' || COALESCE(NULLIF($5,''), gen_random_uuid()::text))
RETURNING id AS payment_id, reference_number, amount, payment_method, payment_date::text;

INSERT INTO bookings.customer_interactions
  (customer_id, customer_name, customer_email, customer_phone,
   booking_id, booking_date, room_name,
   subject, interaction_type, notes, timestamp, staff_member, tenant_id)
VALUES
  ($1::uuid, $2, $3, '',
   NULL, NULL, NULL,
   'Membership payment recorded',
   'membership',
   'Invoice: ' || $4 || ', Paid: £' || $5 || ', Ref: ' || $6 || ', Status: ' || $7,
   NOW(), $8, $9)
RETURNING id;
